component.name: SauceFX
component.summary: Sound EQ and audio enhancement for Linux

description.p: SauceFX is a native Linux sound equalizer and audio enhancement app. It runs the open-source DfxDsp engine, routes system audio through a PipeWire virtual sink, and provides a five-effect rack, a 31-band graphic EQ with a live spectrum visualizer, factory and user presets, dark and light themes, and session restore.

ul.li: Clarity, Ambience, Surround Sound, Dynamic Boost and Bass Boost effects
31-band graphic EQ with live spectrum visualizer
Factory preset library plus import/export and user presets
Native PipeWire virtual sink with automatic output routing
Close-to-background, single-instance restore and optional login autostart

description.p: Detect wired headphone ports, USB audio devices and Bluetooth headsets in the output menu. Switch outputs live and recover after disconnects while preserving effect and equalizer settings.
Improves startup defaults, theme consistency and Linux packaging.
First packaged release with Flatpak and RPM builds.
